Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents an in-app notification for a user.

userId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Notification) User to which the notification is directed.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Represents an uploaded file, such as a template or protocol.

uploaderName.description: The display name of the user who uploaded the file.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Represents a team event or a blocked-off time on the schedule.

description.description: A detailed description of the event.

start.description: The start date and time of the event.

end.description: The end date and time of the event.

participantIds.description: Array of user UIDs participating in the event.

creatorId.description: The UID of the user who created the event.

creatorName.description: The display name of the user who created the event.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to provide a secure, scalable, and easily debuggable system for the PharmaTask application. A key change is the introduction of the `/public_users` collection. This collection stores a subset of user data that is safe to be publicly readable, solving the complex and error-prone permission issues with listing users for the admin panel. Data is duplicated from the private `/users` collection to `/public_users` upon user creation/update. A new `/documents` collection has been added to store metadata about shared files. A new `/equipment` collection is added to track lab equipment.
